name: smwsprites-single-sprite
title: Single Sprite 5 Eeries
description:
This is a version of the "Group of 5 Eeries, Wave Motion" sprite that consolidates all 5 Eeries into a single sprite. This allows many more to be onscreen at one time, and also gives a performance boost over the 5 sprites being handled separately. As an example, the 4th GIF is demonstrated on LoROM with FastROM disabled.

Additionally, you can customize the group X speed, the maximum Y speed and wave speed/amplitude of the group, as well as their direction behaviour.
